name: ANSI/IEEE lockable switch-disconnector symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for lockable switch-disconnector, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The lockable switch-disconnector form combines load switching, isolation and a documented locking provision. These are separate capabilities recorded against the same device, rather than inferred from a single contact gap or padlock outline.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify the permitted locking state in the operator schedule.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Adding a locking modifier to a switch does not prove that it has the isolation function of a switch-disconnector.
